sale_pattern: Frequent Buy One Get One deals
notes: Status: trading. charlotterusse.com is a live Shopify store (861 products in /products.json, 2026-10-29). Meta description: 'Your destination for the latest clothing, footwear and accessory trends. With unbeatable pricing, every woman can afford to feel her best'. About Us: 'your go to for the latest trends at prices you'll love'. Ahrefs SERP questions ask 'Does Charlotte Russe still exist?' and 'Why is Charlotte Russe closing?'; the closure was in 2019 (Wikipedia), and the brand has traded again under YM Inc. since.

Wikipedia: founded 1975 in Carlsbad, California by Daniel Lawrence and his two brothers; filed Chapter 11 on 4 February 2019 and closed its 418 remaining stores; acquired April 2019 by Toronto-based YM Inc.; 183 stores by end of 2019; aimed at women in their teens and twenties. Infobox HQ Toronto; the site footer names CR CLICKS ECOMM INC., 50 Dufflaw Rd, Toronto. hq_country CA from those.

Store locator (the page's own endpoint /apps/api/v1/stores, 2026-10-29): 220 US locations, 191 branded Charlotte Russe (others Urban Planet, a YM sister chain), in 34 states plus Puerto Rico; most in FL (22), TX (17), CA (16), NY (11). 3 marked temporarily closed.
Shipping policy: UPS SurePost, free on $100+, $7.95 under $100; 48 contiguous states only (no Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico, APO/FPO); prices in USD.

Return policy: refunds by mail within 30 days of the order date, return postage not refunded; no exchanges by mail, exchanges in store; online orders returnable in store. Final sale: cosmetics, jewelry, intimates, swimwear, items at 70–80% off and Buy 1 Get 2 Free items. Buy One Get One items must be returned together for a full refund.

Sizes from the product feed (in-stock variants): tops and dresses XS, S/P, M, L/G, XL (XXS and XXL on 4 and 2 items); jeans 00–15. No plus range, so has_plus false. The size-guide page renders its charts client-side.

Product feed vendors: Stitches 575, Urban Ladies 237, CR Licensed 49 (licensed lines such as Playboy, Juicy Couture, Snoopy). Stitches is also the vendor on rue21.com's feed; Wikipedia says YM Inc. owns both chains.

Category C = dresses: Ahrefs top pages for charlotterusse.com (US, 2026-10-28) put /collections/dresses (top keyword 'charlotte russe dresses', est. 74/month) ahead of /collections/jeans (46) among product-type pages (Playboy and boots pages are a licensed line and footwear); beautymag says the brand has 'a particular emphasis on dresses and going-out looks'.
FAQ: 'we do not restock most of our items'; payment by card, Google Pay, Apple Pay; gift cards not accepted online.

2026-10-29 (aeropostale page run): homepage nav Denim: Brooklyn - Baggy, London - Super Baggy, Paris - Wide Leg, Soho - Stretch Super Baggy, plus Bootcut, Flare, Wide Leg, Baggy, Barrel and Embellished Jeans. Banner 'FREE SHIPPING ON ORDERS OVER $100'.
